items.name: Hunter Digital - Marketing
items.description: Award-winning NYC Digital Marketing agency serving ecommerce and B2B. Established in 2010, HUNTER focuses on results-driven marketing such as Google Search, Facebook/Instagram Ads, SEO & Amazon Seller.  Rated 5-Stars by Google Reviews.

items.name: Account Management
items.description: Focuses on managing a company’s interactions with customers and maintaining the relationship over time. It involves managing client accounts to improve satisfaction and retention.

items.name: Account Setup
items.description: Involves creating and setting up accounts on various platforms, ensuring that user profiles and settings are optimized for visibility and engagement.

items.name: Ad Copy
items.description: The text portion of a clickable advertisement, intended to capture a viewer's attention and persuade them to take action, such as clicking through to a webpage.

items.name: Ads Serve
items.description: Refers to the process of serving advertisements to users through various digital channels. This involves the selection, scheduling, placement, and rotation of ads according to predefined strategies and targets.

items.name: Advertising Agencies
items.description: Provide creative and strategic services for planning, creating, buying, and handling advertising and marketing promotions for clients on various media platforms.

items.name: Advertising Solution
items.description: Comprehensive methods and tools used by companies to create, test, and deploy advertising strategies to reach their target audience more effectively.

items.name: Affiliate Marketing
items.description: A marketing arrangement where an online retailer pays commission to an external website for traffic or sales generated from its referrals, often through links on a blog or website.

items.name: Amazon Ads
items.description: Refers to the advertising options available on Amazon's platform, including sponsored products, sponsored brands, and display ads, helping sellers increase their product visibility and sales.

items.name: Amazon Sponsored Products
items.description: Ads that appear in search results and on product pages on Amazon. These ads target shoppers searching for similar products, increasing visibility and potential sales.

items.name: Behavioral Tracking
items.description: The monitoring and recording of users' activities on the internet, including sites visited, content viewed, and actions taken, to create detailed profiles that guide personalized advertising.

items.name: Brand Awareness
items.description: Involves strategies aimed at making your brand known to as broad an audience as possible and ensuring that your brand remains at the forefront of potential buyers' minds.

items.name: Brand Logo
items.description: A graphical identity that represents a company or brand. A logo is a part of the branding strategy that helps people recognize a business product or service.

items.name: Brands Ads
items.description: Advertising that focuses on creating and promoting a recognizable and enduring image or product associated with a particular brand.

items.name: Brands Campaigns
items.description: Coordinated marketing efforts to reinforce or assist with a brand's messaging in the eyes of the consumer. Campaigns can include multiple types of media, channels, and techniques to achieve this.

items.name: Brands Video
items.description: Visual content created to promote a brand, its products, or services. It aims to engage viewers and create brand recognition through compelling narratives or images.

items.name: Business Development
items.description: Involves tasks and processes to develop and implement growth opportunities within and between organizations. It is a subset of the fields of business, commerce, and organizational theory.

items.name: Business Website
items.description: A digital platform that represents a business online. It is a central hub for information about products, services, and company details and serves as a primary point of contact for potential customers.

items.name: Conversion Rate Optimization
items.description: This service focuses on increasing the percentage of visitors to a website who complete a desired action, such as making a purchase or signing up for a newsletter. CRO involves understanding user behavior and optimizing webpage elements to encourage conversions.

items.name: Custom Reports
items.description: Tailored reports that analyze specific aspects of a business or market activity based on data collected from various sources. These are used to inform strategic decisions and track performance against goals.

items.name: Customized Plan
items.description: Tailored strategies designed to meet the specific needs and goals of a business, focusing on areas like marketing, operations, or growth initiatives.

items.name: Data Protection
items.description: Ensures the security of data against unauthorized access, corruption, or theft, and complies with legal regulations regarding privacy.

items.name: Digital Marketing Agency
items.description: Provides a range of marketing services such as SEO, content marketing, PPC, social media marketing, and more, helping businesses achieve their digital marketing objectives.

items.name: Digital Marketing Consulting
items.description: This service provides expert advice and strategies to businesses looking to enhance their online presence and marketing efforts. Consultants analyze a company's digital footprint and recommend improvements across various platforms and channels.

items.name: Digital Marketing Technique
items.description: Methods and strategies used to promote products or services online through various digital channels to reach consumers.

items.name: Digital Media
items.description: Electronic media that work on digital codes, such as websites, social media, and online advertising, used extensively in marketing and communication.

items.name: Digital Strategy
items.description: Involves the formulation of a plan that uses digital resources to achieve business goals. It includes leveraging technologies and channels to improve business performance and create competitive advantages.

items.name: Display Ads
items.description: Visual-based advertisements that appear on network websites across the internet, including banners, square images, and interactive ads, used to promote a brand or product.

items.name: Display Campaigns
items.description: Specific marketing efforts that use display ads to target potential customers across the web, often involving retargeting and broad audience reach.

items.name: Display Marketing
items.description: Utilizes banner ads and other visual advertisements to promote products or services on websites, apps, or social media through ad networks.

items.name: Email Marketing
items.description: Involves sending marketing messages via email to a group of prospects or customers. Effective for keeping customers informed and customizing marketing messages to audience segments.

items.name: Explainer Videos
items.description: Short online videos used to explain a company’s product or service, typically in a fun, engaging, and informative way.

items.name: Facebook Ads
items.description: Targeted ads used on Facebook to reach a specific audience based on demographics, interests, behavior, and more, aiming to increase brand exposure or specific consumer actions.

items.name: Free Consultation
items.description: Often offered by service providers to attract potential customers by giving them a chance to discuss their needs and how the service can meet them without any initial investment.

items.name: Google Ads
items.description: A platform for businesses to create ads that appear on Google’s search engine and other Google properties. It operates on a pay-per-click model, where users bid on keywords and pay for each click on their advertisements.

items.name: Google Adsense Advertising
items.description: A program run by Google through which website publishers in the Google Network of content sites serve text, images, video, or interactive media advertisements that are targeted to the site content and audience.

items.name: Google Analytics
items.description: A web analytics service offered by Google that tracks and reports website traffic, providing insights into user behavior, traffic sources, and the effectiveness of marketing campaigns.

items.name: Google Display Network
items.description: A collection of over two million websites and apps where your ads can appear, reaching over 90% of Internet users worldwide. GDN allows you to display ads in different formats and sizes across a vast network of web pages, apps, and videos.

items.name: Google My Business Optimization
items.description: Enhancing the presence of a business on Google My Business, helping it to appear more prominently in local search results and Google Maps.

items.name: Google's Marketing Services
items.description: Refers to a suite of tools and platforms provided by Google to assist businesses in their marketing efforts, including Google Ads, Google Analytics, Google My Business, and YouTube Advertising.

items.name: Growth Hacking
items.description: Involves using creative, low-cost strategies to help businesses acquire and retain customers. Often used by startups, it focuses on alternative and innovative marketing experiments that lead to high growth in short periods.

items.name: In Individual Marketing
items.description: Marketing efforts tailored to the individual needs and preferences of customers, often using personalized communications and offers.

items.name: Influencer Marketing
items.description: A form of marketing that focuses on using key leaders to drive your brand's message to the larger market. Instead of marketing directly to a large group of consumers, you instead inspire, hire, or pay influencers to get out the word for you.

items.name: Influencer Outreach
items.description: The process of identifying and engaging with individuals who have influence over potential buyers and initiating a collaboration to promote a brand, product, or service.

items.name: Linkedin Marketing
items.description: This involves using LinkedIn for promoting products or services, particularly in B2B markets. Strategies include content creation, targeted ads, and networking with industry professionals to boost brand visibility and generate leads.

items.name: Local Seo Strategy
items.description: Focuses on optimizing a business’s online presence to attract more business from relevant local searches. These searches take place on Google and other search engines that allow users to find local businesses.

items.name: Local Websites
items.description: Websites focused on serving the interests and needs of a local community or region, often including local news, events, and business directories.

items.name: Marketing Automation
items.description: Uses software to automate marketing activities. Many marketing departments automate repetitive tasks such as email marketing, social media posting, and even ad campaigns—not just for efficiency, but so they can provide a more personalized experience for their customers.

items.name: Marketing Communication
items.description: Strategies and tactics used to reach an audience, including advertising, public relations, direct marketing, and more, to promote a brand or product.

items.name: Marketing Materials
items.description: Physical or digital items designed to communicate a company's brand and product benefits, such as brochures, flyers, and digital content.

items.name: Marketing Plan
items.description: A comprehensive document or blueprint that outlines a company's advertising and marketing efforts for the coming year. It describes business activities involved in accomplishing specific marketing objectives within a set time frame.

items.name: Marketing Search Engine Optimization
items.description: Refers to strategies and practices aimed at increasing the visibility and ranking of marketing content on search engines. It ensures that the marketing content is optimized to be easily found by the target audience.

items.name: Marketing Tactics
items.description: Specific actions or strategies chosen to achieve marketing objectives, such as email campaigns, social media posts, or loyalty programs.

items.name: Marketplace Manage
items.description: Overseeing the operations and strategies of an online marketplace, including vendor relations, product listings, and customer service.

items.name: Media Planning
items.description: The process of strategizing, negotiating, and purchasing ad placements, or "media." This process entails determining the best combination of media to achieve the marketing campaign objectives.

items.name: Network Advertising
items.description: A form of advertising where ads are purchased on a network of relevant websites within the chosen demographic, aimed at increasing reach.

items.name: Online Marketing
items.description: Also known as digital marketing, it involves using web-based channels to promote a company’s brand, products, or services to its potential customers. Methods include social media, search engines, email, and other websites to connect with current and prospective customers.

items.name: Online Marketing Agency
items.description: A service provider focused on creating, implementing, and managing marketing campaigns conducted through various online channels. They aim to increase brand awareness and market penetration for their clients through digital means.

items.name: Online Marketplace
items.description: A type of e-commerce site where product or service information is provided by multiple third parties, and transactions are processed by the marketplace operator.

items.name: Online Optimization
items.description: Ensures that digital assets of a business such as websites, social media pages, and ad campaigns are fully optimized to achieve higher performance and engagement from the target audience.

items.name: Online Strategy
items.description: Refers to a planned approach to using online resources and channels to support overall business and marketing goals. This can include digital marketing, social media, e-commerce, and more.

items.name: Organic Search
items.description: Involves strategies aimed at improving unpaid results in search engines (as opposed to paid advertisements). It relies heavily on SEO best practices and content relevance to the user's search query.

items.name: Out Of Website Optimization
items.description: Techniques used to improve the visibility and performance of a website through external means, such as backlinking and social media engagement.

items.name: Paid Ad Campaigns
items.description: Involve the placement of advertisements across digital platforms where expenses are incurred when the audience engages with the ad (through impressions, clicks, or conversions).

items.name: Paid Search Marketing
items.description: Involves placing ads on search engines like Google that appear when specific keywords are searched. This method is effective for generating immediate traffic and leads, with businesses paying only when their ad is clicked.

items.name: Paid Search Strategy
items.description: A method of digital marketing where marketers pay a fee to have their website displayed on SERP when someone types in specific keywords or phrases to the search engine. The pay-per-click (PPC) model is the most common.

items.name: Platform Integration
items.description: The process of integrating various marketing and technology platforms to streamline processes, improve data consistency, and enhance user experiences.

items.name: Ppc Management
items.description: Involves managing a company’s PPC ad spend. This often strategies and ad buys while minimizing the overall expenditure. This can be done by the merchants themselves, or they might hire a dedicated specialist company to manage PPC buys on their behalf.

items.name: Product Ads
items.description: Advertisements that focus specifically on the promotion and sale of products through various advertising platforms like Google Ads or Amazon.

items.name: Project Management
items.description: The discipline of planning, organizing, securing, managing, leading, and controlling resources to achieve specific goals within a project.

items.name: Sales Automation
items.description: The use of software to automate sales functions such as lead tracking, contact management, and sales forecasting, improving efficiency and effectiveness.

items.name: Search Engine Optimization
items.description: Aims to increase a website's visibility in the organic search results of search engines. It involves optimizing website content and structure to improve rankings for specific keywords and phrases.

items.name: Search Engine Optimization Local Seo
items.description: Optimizing a website to increase visibility and rank higher in local search engine results, focusing on local keywords and content.

items.name: Seo Audit
items.description: An inspection of a website with the goal of identifying issues and opportunities for improvement in search engine performance.

items.name: Social Media Advertising
items.description: The use of social media platforms to connect with your audience to build your brand, increase sales, and drive website traffic. This involves publishing great content on your social media profiles, listening to and engaging your followers, analyzing your results, and running social media advertiseme

items.name: Social Media Marketing
items.description: This service helps businesses engage with customers and prospects on social media platforms like Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram through content sharing, ads, and interactive engagements.

items.name: Sound Design
items.description: The art and practice of creating sound tracks for various needs such as films, television, games, and live performances.

items.name: Targeted Ad
items.description: Ads directed towards audiences identified as likely prospects based on various criteria such as demographics, behaviors, psychographics, or user-specific data like location or browsing history.

items.name: User Experience Design
items.description: The process of enhancing user satisfaction by improving the usability, accessibility, and pleasure provided in the interaction between the user and the product

items.name: Video Ad
items.description: A short video clip that advertises a product, service, or brand, typically featured in online platforms or broadcast media.

items.name: Video Ads
items.description: Online advertisements that incorporate video content which can be targeted, measurable, and interactive. They can appear before, during, or after streaming content.

items.name: Video Production
items.description: The process of creating video content, which involves pre-production, production, and post-production stages.

items.name: Website Hosting
items.description: A service that allows individuals and organizations to make their website accessible via the World Wide Web, providing technologies and services needed for the website to be viewed on the internet.

items.name: Yelp Marketing
items.description: Utilizing Yelp to promote a business, manage reputation, or advertise to local customers, leveraging the platform’s extensive user base and review system.

items.name: amazon seller services
items.description: Helps sellers on Amazon improve their store's visibility and sales. Services include optimization of product listings, pricing strategies, inventory management, and customer service enhancements.

items.name: facebook advertising
items.description: Involves creating targeted advertisements for audiences on Facebook to increase brand exposure, user engagement, or drive website traffic. It leverages Facebook's extensive user data for precise targeting.

items.name: google shopping
items.description: Allows retailers to showcase their products directly in Google search results, making it easier for consumers to make purchase decisions based on product offerings, prices, and reviews.
